treatment_plan.definitive: After removing the original restoration, we will review the condition of the abutment teeth and formulate a detailed diagnosis and treatment plan.
treatment_plan.notes: Instructions for follow-up consultation for discomfort include chewing a cotton roll for 40 minutes and not brushing teeth and gargling for 24 hours. You can eat and drink after 2 hours. It is recommended that the food should not be too hot. See (Precautions after tooth extraction) for details.
